description: Manages distributed alarm zones with local sensors, MQTT events, SMS control, and event logging.
Runs micrOS commands received over MQTT and publishes JSON responses through an asynchronous client.
Provides an asynchronous OLED interface with pages, popups, and trackball navigation for SSD1306 and SH1106 displays.
Demonstrates controlling a single LED from the micrOS shell or web interface.
Controls an OV2640 camera with photo capture, image settings, and web snapshot and streaming endpoints.
Supports MH-Z19 CO2 measurements and calibrated MQ-135 air-quality estimates.
Reads RGB and ambient light from a TCS3472 sensor with optional NeoPixel color visualization.
Controls DC motor speed and direction through L298N and L9110 drivers.
Controls a garage door and alarm through an RF remote using authorized phone calls and SMS commands.
Reads acceleration, angular velocity, and temperature from QMI8658 and QMI8658C motion sensors.
Drives a vibration motor with PWM tap and effect helpers for haptic feedback.
Provides a beta garden irrigation dashboard with tank monitoring, water-volume calculations, and watering plans.
Demonstrates an ESP32-C3 keychain with OLED status, temperature readings, a screen saver, and NeoPixel control.
Measures ambient light intensity and illuminance with TEMPT6000 and VEML7700.
Controls NeoPixel matrices with animations, frame playback, brightness adjustment, and a web drawing interface.
Manages persistent phonebooks with user roles and time-limited access permissions.
Provides a beta LD2410 presence sensor interface with readings and firmware queries over a serial connection.
Generates QR codes for CPython and MicroPython using built-in language features.
Controls a two-servo robotic arm with smooth movement, position recording, and playback.
Connects SIM800 GSM modems for calls, SMS, USSD, notifications, and HTTP or MQTT over GPRS.
Learns and classifies sound events captured by an I2S microphone using stored labeled examples.
Measures distance in millimeters with a VL53L0X time-of-flight sensor over I2C.
Reads movement and button presses from a Pimoroni trackball with configurable sensitivity.
Measures distance in centimeters or millimeters using HC-SR04 and RCWL-1670 ultrasonic sensors.
Provides a device-hosted browser console for enabling and accessing the MicroPython WebREPL.
